title: 第99章：跟他们拼了！
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏晚吟喝了水，精神好了许多。

她带着敌军，在荒地里走了许久。

士兵们见天色已然大亮，而他们还在原地打转。

有士兵忍不住道：“头儿，这丫头在耍咱们，一直带着咱们在这附近兜圈子呢！”

“不，我没有耍你们。我真的知道铁矿在哪儿，只是……只是我找不到去废弃城楼的路了。”

苏晚吟紧张得抿着唇，生怕对方也会把她丢下。

为首的将领皱眉，低头看向她，“你说铁矿在废弃城楼那边？”

“对，就在那边！”苏晚吟连连点头。

她的话刚落下，另一名士兵不屑地冷哼。

“还说不是耍我们。我们之前就去过城楼，那里根本没有铁矿！”

“有的，铁矿就在城楼下藏着，不信你们去把城楼移开！”

苏晚吟心跳如鼓，紧张地看向为首的将领。

她在赌，赌他们会相信她。

等他们找到了铁矿，她就可以离开这个鬼地方，再也不用遭人白眼了！

“铁矿怎么可能在城楼下埋着？”士兵摇头，“将士，这个小丫头明显是在骗咱们，咱们可不能上当！”

“城楼下有没有铁矿，过去看看不就知道了？”

说着，将士调转马头，朝着废弃城楼的方向赶去。

士兵们见样，连忙跟上去。

帐篷群里，众人吃完早饭，来到矿区下井。

昨日安安说，苏晚吟会带官兵前来，他们便一直耐心等待着。

等到官兵离开，才开始干活。

一整天下来，有一半的时间都在等待中度过，并没有干多少活。

昨日的工分，是挖矿以来最少的一天。

虽然大家还有不少工分，但工分跟银子一样，谁会嫌银子多呢？

“兄弟们，咱们昨天都没赚到什么工分，大家今天得努力了！”

刘大勇拿起风钻，照常给众人打气。

苏安安无事可做，将工具分给众人后，坐在角落里发了会儿呆。

想到盖房子要用的砖头，似乎不剩多少了。

她圆溜溜的眼眸一亮，起身看向秦昭岚。

“娘亲，我上去搬砖啦！”

“我陪你一起去。”

“不用啦，娘亲留下来帮叔叔们吧！”

苏安安摆了摆小手，迈着小短腿往上面走。

知道苏安安的能力，秦昭岚倒也放心。

继续守着炸药包，等待引爆的时机。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Su Wanyin drank water and felt much better.

She led the enemy troops and walked in the wasteland for a long time.

The soldiers saw that it was already daylight, but they were still spinning in place.

Some soldiers couldn't help but said: "Boss, this girl is playing tricks on us. She keeps leading us around in circles!"

"No, I'm not kidding you. I really know where the iron ore is, but...it's just that I can't find the way to the abandoned tower."

Su Wanyin pursed her lips nervously, fearing that the other party would also abandon her.

The leading general frowned and looked down at her, "You said the iron ore is over there at the abandoned tower?"

"Yes, right over there!" Su Wanyin nodded repeatedly.

As soon as she finished speaking, another soldier snorted disdainfully.

"He said he was not playing tricks on us. We have been to the city tower before, and there is no iron ore there at all!"

"Yes, the iron ore is hidden under the gate tower. If you don't believe me, go and move the gate tower!"

Su Wanyin's heartbeat was beating like a drum, and she looked nervously at the leading general.

She was betting that they would believe her.

When they find the iron ore, she can leave this hellish place and no longer have to be looked down upon!

"How is it possible that iron ore is buried under the city tower?" The soldier shook his head, "Sir, this little girl is obviously lying to us. We can't be fooled!"

"Is there any iron ore under the city tower? Can't we find out if we go over there and take a look?"

With that said, the soldiers turned their horses and rushed towards the abandoned tower.

The soldiers saw this and quickly followed.

In the tent group, everyone finished breakfast and went to the mining area to go down the shaft.

An An said yesterday that Su Wanyin would bring officers and soldiers, so they have been waiting patiently.

Wait until the officers and soldiers leave before starting to work.

Half of the whole day was spent waiting and not much work was done.

Yesterday’s work points were the lowest since mining.

Although everyone still has a lot of work points, the work points are the same as money. Who would think that there is too much money?

"Brothers, we didn't earn any work points yesterday. We all have to work hard today!"

Liu Dayong picked up the pneumatic drill and cheered everyone up as usual.

Su Anan had nothing to do. After distributing the tools to everyone, he sat in the corner and stared blankly for a while.

Thinking about the bricks needed to build a house, it seems there are not many left.

Her round eyes lit up, and she stood up and looked at Qin Zhaolan.

"Mom, I'm going to move the bricks!"

"I'll go with you."

"No need, mother, please stay and help the uncles!"

Su Anan waved her little hands and walked up with her short legs.

Knowing Su An'an's abilities, Qin Zhaolan felt relieved.

Continue to guard the explosive package, waiting for the opportunity to detonate.
